2026-11-24: Homebrew cask pd installs Pd 0.57.0 as /Applications/Pd-0.57-0.app; the pd binary is not on PATH, so the fixture calls Contents/Resources/bin/pd (overridable with PD_BIN).

2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written at skills/pure-data/SKILL.md from the pure-data-batch-render evidence; scope stays batch render of one hand-written patch, no externals, real-time audio, MIDI or GUI.

evidence.result: Hand-written patch: osc~ 440 Hz through a vline~ envelope (ramp to 0.5 over 50 ms, release to 0 over 300 ms from 1.5 s) into writesf~; pd -nogui -batch -r 48000 writes 96000 frames (2.000 s), 16-bit mono 48 kHz, plateau 0.5. Rise and fall at 10% and 90% within 0.6 ms of prediction (bound 2 ms); FFT tone 440.04 Hz, 0.15 cents (bound 5); tail silent; two reruns byte-identical and identical to the recorded summary.
evidence.scope: batch render of a hand-written osc~/vline~ patch to 16-bit mono 48 kHz WAV, 2.0 s; envelope, 440 Hz and rerun checks; no listening or realtime audio; macOS arm64

summary: Visual dataflow environment for sound and multimedia. Native Pd patches express realtime processing; automation and offline rendering depend on the patch and runtime configuration.
use_when: Explore interactive signal flows with editable patches

assessment.rationale: Official sources describe an automation route; release and substantive-commit dates could not be fully established. Keep candidate pending further review.
